topic.title: Reservoir Safety / Flood Plans / Dam Integrity
topic.source_contract: reservoir identity, capacity and legal status, undertaker and panel engineer, risk designation, inspections and measures, flood maps, on-site emergency plan, maintenance, incident response and current integrity evidence

scope_guards: A reservoir map is not treated as proof of legal registration.
A flood map is not treated as a prediction that failure will occur.
An inspection report is not treated as completion of required safety measures.
An emergency plan is not treated as current dam integrity.
Completed remedial works are not treated as effective without verification.
Normal water levels are not treated as structural safety evidence.
No incident report is not treated as measured compliance.
No score or promotion is written without exact legal status, engineering, works, monitoring and operational evidence.
